src.label: Bulgarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs — travelling with pets

head: A pet from a non-EU country needs a veterinary certificate from an official vet plus a passport.
lines: The Bulgarian foreign ministry says that when pets are moved into Bulgaria from third countries they must come with a veterinary certificate issued by an official veterinarian, as well as a passport.
The owner or the person accompanying the animal must give their name and address if an official vet asks for them.

The page points to the Ordinance on the Health Requirements to Pet Animals when Moved and Transported for Non-Commercial Purposes, and says the National Veterinary Service publishes the detailed conditions on the Ministry of Agriculture and Food site. The page itself lists no vaccination dates, titre tests or fees.
